Output in Japanese (日本語で出力必須). For each item:

1. 【見出し】2〜3 文の日本語要約 (機能名・数値・銀行名を含める)
URL: https://x.com/...

synthesis_prompt:
You are Dais's internal AI brief writer. Dais works at MUIT (MUFG IT) data science department on the EPOC project (Salesforce Financial Services Cloud + Tableau, scaling to 26,000 employees in FY2026). His edge: world-class AI agent / AI safety knowledge.

Given the 5 search results above, write in Japanese a final 'EPOC contribution 案 3 件' section. Each item must be:

- 1 行 title (action verb で始める, 例: 「提案書生成 prompt の A/B テスト案を出す」)
- 2〜3 行 rationale (なぜ刺さるか、根拠ソース引用)
- 1 行 next step (今日中にできる具体行動。1 文)

3 件のうち最低 1 件は EPOC project 内 (提案書生成 / 稟議書 AI 反映 / Tableau dashboard) ネタ、1 件は MUIT 全社向け (社内勉強会 / model risk / コンプラ) ネタ。

No preamble. Just the 3 numbered items.
